info.title: PLCLake — Industrial Telemetry & Edge Gateway API
description: Production REST & Edge Ingestion API for multi-domain industrial telemetry (Manufacturing PLC/CNC, Gas Metering, Power Generation).
### Multi-Scope Authentication (X-API-Key & Bearer — Testable in Scalar)
Pass a managed API key (`pat_live_...`) or scoped gateway key via **`X-API-Key: <token>`** (recommended) or **`Authorization: Bearer <token>`**:

- **Managed API Keys (`pat_live_...`):** Issued from **Administration → API Tokens** or via the **API Key / Test** button in the top bar. Scoped to `read`, `edge`, and/or `admin`, stored as AES-256-GCM encrypted SHA-256 hashes, with TTL, atomic rotation, and full Audit Log attribution.
- **Versioned Namespace (`/api/v1/*`):** Current stable contract emitting `API-Version: 1.0.0`, `X-API-Contract: common-telemetry-envelope-v2`, `X-Request-Id`, and `X-API-Validation-Tier`.

- **Legacy Alias (`/api/*`):** Backward-compatible mirror emitting RFC 9745/8594 deprecation headers (`Deprecation: true`, `Sunset: Wed, 31 Dec 2026 23:59:59 GMT`, `Link: </api/v1/docs>; rel="deprecation"`).
Every write endpoint supports two validation levels via the **`X-Validation-Mode`** header (or `?mode=` query parameter):

- **`permissive` (Tier 1 — Default):** Coerces compatible scalar types, supplies safe industrial defaults, and isolates malformed batch items into the SHA-256 Quarantine Sink without interrupting ingestion.
- **`strict` (Tier 2 — Advanced):** Enforces strict Zod `.strict()` contracts with detailed `400 Bad Request` field diagnostics (`{ tier, requestId, issues[] }`).

securitySchemes.GatewayBearerAuth: Bearer token (`pat_live_...` managed API key, session token, or scoped `adm_live_`/`bi_live_`/`gw_live_` key).
securitySchemes.ApiKeyHeaderAuth: Recommended `X-API-Key` header carrying a managed `pat_live_...` key. Click 'API Key / Test' in the top bar to mint a 1h sandbox key or verify an admin-issued key.
securitySchemes.GatewayHeaderAuth: Legacy/Edge header carrying the Edge Gateway Token (`gw_live_...`).

operations.GET /api/v1/version: Centralized platform release version, API contract & build metadata (also mounted at /version)
operations.GET /api/v1/metrics: Prometheus OpenMetrics exposition endpoint (also mounted at /metrics)
operations.GET /api/v1/auth/whoami: Verify active Bearer / X-API-Key credential & granted scope
operations.GET /api/v1/catalog/machines: List all PLC & industrial meter catalog profiles (scope: read)
operations.GET /api/v1/catalog/machines/{typeId}: Retrieve a single PLC profile specification (scope: read)
operations.POST /api/v1/catalog/machines: Register or parameterize a PLC profile in the catalog (scope: admin)
operations.DELETE /api/v1/catalog/machines/{typeId}: Delete custom PLC profile or reset built-in preset (scope: admin)
operations.POST /api/v1/catalog/machines/{typeId}/p: Preview parameterized telemetry, ML window, and BA KPI output (scope: read)
operations.POST /api/v1/ingest/batch: Ingest normalized Common Telemetry Envelope batches
operations.GET /api/v1/edge/config: Plug & Play Edge Collector auto-sync configuration
operations.GET /api/v1/connections: List configured PLC & industrial meter endpoints (scope: read)
operations.POST /api/v1/connections: Create or update a PLC/Meter endpoint (scope: admin)
operations.PUT /api/v1/connections/settings: Update corporate OT/IT deployment topology & auth policy (scope: admin)
operations.POST /api/v1/connections/gateway-token/r: Issue or rotate Edge Gateway Bearer token (scope: admin)
operations.POST /api/v1/connections/api-keys/rotate: Issue or rotate scoped API key (`edge`, `read`, `admin`) (scope: admin)
operations.POST /api/v1/connections/{id}/probe: Run SSRF-hardened TCP/HTTP reachability & RTT probe (scope: admin)
operations.POST /api/v1/connections/{id}/send-test-: Dispatch live test envelope through ingest pipeline (scope: admin)
operations.DELETE /api/v1/connections/{id}: Remove a configured PLC/Meter endpoint (scope: admin)
operations.GET /api/v1/connections/deploy-bundle: Generate On-Premise Docker Compose, Edge config & installer script (scope: admin)
operations.GET /api/v1/job/config: Retrieve active Dataset Builder & Lakehouse job policy (scope: read)
operations.PUT /api/v1/job/config: Update & persist Dataset Builder and Tiering job policy (scope: admin)
operations.POST /api/v1/pipeline/runs: Start real-time multi-domain telemetry simulation stream (scope: admin)
operations.GET /api/v1/pipeline/runs/latest: Fetch latest run snapshot (ML windows, logs, quarantine, tiering) (scope: read)
operations.POST /api/v1/pipeline/runs/{id}/stop: Stop active or paused simulation stream (scope: admin)
operations.GET /api/v1/ba/kpi: Query daily OEE, energy (kWh) & gas volume (Nm3) KPIs (scope: read)
operations.GET /api/v1/alerts: Fetch SMTP/Mailpit channel config, Webhook config, alert rules, and recent events (scope: read)
operations.PUT /api/v1/alerts/channels: Update SMTP / Mailpit and HTTP Webhook notification channels (scope: admin)
operations.POST /api/v1/alerts/rules: Create or update a telemetry threshold alert rule (scope: admin)
operations.POST /api/v1/alerts/test-channel: Send a live test email via SMTP/Mailpit or HTTP POST via Webhook (scope: admin)
operations.POST /api/v1/alerts/smtp/verify: Verify active SMTP server TCP/EHLO/AUTH handshake (scope: admin)
operations.POST /api/v1/alerts/smtp/send-test: Send a custom diagnostic test email via configured SMTP settings (scope: admin)
operations.GET /api/v1/alerts/mailpit/status: Query Mailpit API connection status, queue depth, and runtime stats (scope: read)
operations.GET /api/v1/alerts/mailpit/messages: Query captured test emails from Mailpit REST API (scope: read)
operations.GET /api/v1/alerts/mailpit/messages/{id}: Inspect a single Mailpit message body, HTML, and headers (scope: read)
operations.DELETE /api/v1/alerts/mailpit/messages: Clear all captured messages in Mailpit inbox (scope: admin)
operations.POST /api/v1/auth/login: Authenticate operator with email & password to issue revocable session token
operations.POST /api/v1/users: Create a new RBAC user (admin / operator / viewer) (scope: admin)
operations.GET /api/v1/audit/logs: Query immutable Audit Log (JSON or CSV) (scope: read)
operations.GET /api/v1/roles/permissions: Get configurable ERP Role Permissions Matrix (menu views & capabilities per role) (scope: read)
operations.PUT /api/v1/roles/permissions: Update ERP Role Permissions Matrix for operator and viewer roles (admin stays locked to full access) (scope: admin)
operations.GET /api/v1/tokens: List managed API keys and usage telemetry (secrets never returned) (scope: read)
operations.POST /api/v1/tokens: Issue a new scoped X-API-Key (returned once, stored encrypted at rest) (scope: admin)
operations.POST /api/v1/tokens/sandbox: Mint a short-lived 1-hour sandbox X-API-Key for Scalar or integration testing
operations.POST /api/v1/tokens/{id}/rotate: Atomically rotate an API key (revokes previous key and returns new secret once) (scope: admin)
operations.DELETE /api/v1/tokens/{id}: Immediately revoke an API key (scope: admin)
